report.TASK: GK2: the policy file from the approved numbers, the readers of one key name, the rehearsal rule.
WORKS: The pending policy file holds the approved prices, caps and eleven key names; both statements are null.
The gateway's schema refuses it as written, on exactly those two fields; with both true in memory it
The plan at that policy: 10 calls, estimate ₹1.15, at most ₹7.75 of ₹100 (30.97% of the ₹25 day).
A used-up key list reaches the mapping teacher as TEACHER_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, not TEACHER_UNAVAILABLE.
The officer provider's status check accepts a list with every key present and names an absent one.
The one-call mapping qualifier accepts one Sarvam key or a list, and refuses an absent key by name
A keys rehearsal without --settings prints the usage text and reads nothing; with it, one new file.
SEE_IT: docs/backend/DEMO-GATEWAY.md, section: Approved on 10 October 2026, and the pending file
INPUTS: The owner's decisions of 10 October as the task file and AGENTS.md state them.
The plan's own inputs: committed fixtures and the development and demo storey stores it already reads.
Synthetic keys made inside the tests. No real key, no demo settings, no provider call, no database.
GAPS: The two statements are not confirmed: the pending file cannot be enabled, and no approved file exists.
The input bound (34816) and pace (1500 ms) are the schema's smallest values, not operator-qualified
bounds; the bound's label says so (schema-minimum/not-approved) and is part of the policy hash.
Another label, or any other change, gives another hash: run check-policy.ts and the plan again.
fundingVersion says eleven keys of free credit. H20 line 15 says Sarvam's credit belongs to an account,
not a key; whether the eleven keys are eleven accounts is the owner's knowledge. The ₹100 cap does
The qualifier with every key present was run only up to a file that does not exist; no live run.
The officer provider checks that each key name is present, as before; it does not read a value, so an
empty value still counts as present there (the gateway itself refuses it at the call).
With --live and a policy the schema refuses, the qualifier still ends as the teacher's own refusal
(TEACHER_UNAVAILABLE), as before; only an absent or non-Sarvam key name is refused by name.
Three neighbour tests fail on staging without this task and fail the same way with it (see checks).
Two pinned producer sources changed; docs/api was not regenerated.

were already exported; config.ts is unchanged.
